title: Stochastic fractional heat equation with general rough noise
summary: Consider the following nonlinear one-dimensional stochastic fractional heat equation $$\frac{\partial }{\partial t}u(t, x)= -(-Δ)^{α/2}u(t, x) +σ(t,x,u(t,x)) \dot{W}(t, x), $$ where $-(-Δ)^{α/2}$ is the fractional Laplacian on $\mathbb R$ for $1<α<2$, and $\dot{W}$ is a Gaussian noise that is white in time and behaves in space as a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst index $H$ satisfying $\frac{3-α}{4}<H<\frac12$.
